Protests Erupt at Kerala University Over Vande Mataram Seminar

Protests broke out at the Central University of Kerala over a seminar on Vande Mataram, with demonstrators chanting 'RSS Go Back'. The protests were reportedly linked to the presence of an RSS-affiliated leader at the event. During the demonstrations, three individuals sustained injuries.
